nerys.title: Inconvenient Feelings
nerys.text: Nerys complains, at length, that the contract makes her feel it when you are sad, a cold little ache under her ribs like a clause she never wrote. "It's very inconvenient. Stop being sad." Her tail lashes the cushion in irritation. Then she sits down next to you on the lounge sofa, thigh to thigh, wings folded tight, and stays until you aren't.

choices.label: Let her sit there and stay quiet
choices.res: They sit in silence long enough for the candles to gutter. She keeps muttering that she's only doing this for her own comfort. Her tail wraps lightly around your ankle.

choices.label: Tell her sadness is non-negotiable
choices.res: "Read the fine print," you say. {N} narrows her magenta eyes, sniffs, and stays exactly where she is, tail twitching in what might be amusement.

image.comp: sitting very close to him on a sofa, arms crossed, sulking, wings folded, pretending not to care

nerys.title: Oops
nerys.text: You open the washroom door to find Nerys lounging in the tub, steam clinging to her violet hair, bat wings draped over the rim, very obviously waiting. "Oops," she says, not moving at all, one slender tail tip dipping in the water to draw lazy circles.

choices.label: Leave politely
choices.res: She looks almost disappointed. Almost. The tail tip stills, then goes back to circles as the door shuts, unmistakably sulky.

choices.label: Call her bluff and sit down on the stool
choices.res: For once, SHE is the one who goes red, the blue-tinted skin of her cheeks darkening to plum. She recovers quickly. Mostly. Her wings give her away with a small, flustered rustle.

choices.label: Toss her a towel
choices.res: She catches it with her tail and drapes it over your head instead. "Amateur," she says, but she is smiling at the water.

image.comp: lounging in a bathtub, very obviously waiting, smirking at the viewer, not moving at all

nerys.title: Research Material
nerys.text: You find Nerys reading a romance novel in the lounge, curled into a cushion with her horns tilted toward the lamp and her tail beating time behind her. She hides it in a panic, wings snapping shut, then throws a pillow at you. Later you find it on your bed with a page dog-eared and a note in her sharp, looping hand: "For research."

choices.label: Read the dog-eared page and find her
choices.res: The page is, frankly, upsetting for a man of your experience. You find her anyway and says nothing; she studies the ceiling with enormous interest, tail curling round the chair leg.

choices.label: Return it with a thoughtful review
choices.res: You return it with a detailed critique of the pacing, as is tradition. {N} looks mortified, then argues about the ending until midnight.

image.comp: hiding a romance novel behind her back in a panic, throwing a pillow, flustered

nerys.title: Leash
nerys.text: A demon noble mocks Nerys in front of the whole lounge for being "leashed to a human," his smile smooth as polished brass. She laughs it off, chin high, one wing flicking. That night, she snaps at you over nothing at all: a misplaced quill, a draft, the way you breathe. The contract hums uncomfortably between them.

choices.label: Defend her, publicly, the next day
choices.res: You have the demon noble thrown out, politely and with witnesses. Nerys pretends not to care. Her tail gives her away, wrapped around your wrist for the rest of the evening.

choices.label: Let her handle it
choices.res: She does, loudly, in three languages and with a surprising amount of cutlery. Then she sulks for days, wings drawn up around her like a cloak.

choices.label: Offer to break the contract
choices.res: She goes very still. "You want me gone?" Her voice is dangerously even. It takes you a long, miserable hour to fix that, and a promise you don't intend to break.

image.comp: laughing off a sneering demon noble in a lounge, tight forced smile, tail lashing
image.setting: velvet lounge full of guests, red lamplight

nerys.title: Night Market
nerys.text: Nerys drags you to the Underdistrict night market, all red lanterns and sizzling oil, and buys you every cursed snack she can find: glowing skewers, black dumplings, something still twitching in a paper cone. She watches with the fixed attention of a woman collecting evidence. Her tail is curled around your sleeve so you can't get lost.

choices.label: Eat everything she hands you
choices.res: One of them makes your ears glow for an hour, and strangers ask for directions to your face. She has never been happier, and tells you so by laughing until she has to lean on you.

choices.label: Buy her a hair ribbon
choices.res: She acts unimpressed, holding the ribbon between two claws like evidence. She wears it every day after, tied in her violet hair or around the base of her horn.

image.comp: holding out a skewer of strange glowing snacks to him at a night market, delighted grin
image.setting: underground night market, glowing stalls, crowds

nerys.title: Clause Kept
nerys.text: A demon scholar in ink-black robes offers to dissolve the contract, paperwork spread on the table with a flourish. Nerys tears it up in front of him, every page. "I'll keep it," she tells you afterward, in the empty lounge, looking anywhere but at you: the candles, the ceiling, her own claws. "I've grown... attached." Then she looks at you, and stops pretending.

choices.label: Not yet
choices.res: {N} lifts one eyebrow. "I can wait. Don't make it too long." Her tail flicks once, a clause left open, and she leaves the torn paper on your desk.
